verdicts.rationale: Clean reproduction confirmed divergence between exact:true (6) and exact:false (4) on is_empty filter with 30-point test collection (40% empty: 12/30). Scroll ground truth returns 6 points, confirming exact path is correct. Size-variation control (10-point collection, 40% empty: 4/10) shows consistent 50% undercount pattern (exact=4, approx=2), ruling out by-design fallback heuristic (which would scale linearly). Root cause located in lib/segment/src/index/field_index/null_index/read_ops.rs line 182: estimate_cardinality for is_empty=true uses arbitrary 2/3 heuristic (exp: 2 * estimated / 3) assuming 1/3 deleted points, with no statistical basis. For keyword-indexed fields, the NullIndex already has exact counts via has_values_flags bitmap but estimator ignores this data and returns approximated 2/3 of true cardinality. This is a Type2_PoorDiagnostics bug in the indexed approximate path: count API promises same result regardless of exact parameter when index provides sufficient data, but estimator math is fundamentally wrong for is_empty condition class on keyword payload indexes. Matched cardinality_oracle shape D2 (known instance #10096) and pattern from bug_shapes.json: count(exact:false) systematically undercounts for specific filter condition (is_empty on indexed keyword field) while other condition classes remain correct, isolating bug to one estimator (null_index::read_ops::estimate_cardinality). Three-perspective confirmation: implementation review shows code bug (line 182), reproduction shows behavioral divergence (33-50% undercount), source grounding confirms null index serves is_empty but estimator uses 2/3 heuristic instead of exact bitmap counts available to it.
